pageTitle: cyYou’re eligible to use this service
heading: cyYou’re eligible to use this service
paragraphs: cyBased on the information you’ve provided, you’re eligible to use this service.
cyTo finish making your claim, you’ll need:
bullets: cyinformation about the tenancy or licence
cyinformation about your grounds for possession
cydetails about the notice you served
cydetails of the people who are in possession of the property (the defendants)
cycopies of relevant documents, including the tenancy agreement, notice and a rent statement (if the claim is on the grounds of rent arrears)
afterBullets: cyThe defendants will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
cyYour claim will save as you go, so you can stop and return to it if you need to. You can review and edit your answers before you submit your claim.
cyYou must sign a statement of truth before you submit your claim. This certifies that you believe the information you’re providing is true.
